official_faq.question: I was attacked by my opponent's Character, and used this Character's [On Your Opponent's Attack] effect to set 1 of my DON!! cards to active. Can I then use the [On Your Opponent's Attack] effect of my Leader "OP07-019 Jewelry Bonney" to rest that DON!! card during the same attack?

If I'm attacked by my opponent when I only have active DON!! cards in my cost area, can I choose not to use this [On Your Opponent's Attack] effect, use an Event or other card to rest 1 of my DON!! cards during that attack, and then use this effect the next time my opponent attacks?
official_faq.answer: No, you cannot. [On Your Opponent's Attack] effects will always activate when your opponent attacks, and even if you do not set 1 of your DON!! cards as active, you cannot activate it again for the rest of the turn.
